title: Plan Handoff v1
description: Schema for .rddf/state/.plan-handoff.json emitted by guide-plan Phase 4 plan-done. Consumed by guide-ship Phase 1 (ship_plan.sh) and ship_archive.sh.

plan_complete_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when plan-done was completed

active_changes.description: Number of active changes at plan-done time

all_artifacts_committed.description: True if all change artifacts are committed to git

ship_started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when guide-ship started, or null before first ship entry

current_change.description: Name of the first active change (or null if none)

execution_mode_decisions.description: Per-change execution mode decisions from deps analysis (ADR-0024). Keyed by change name.
